test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the post-reform era, fiscal prudence became central to macroeconomic stability. Which of the following Acts was enacted in 2003 to institutionalise fiscal discipline in India?

options.text: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act was enacted in **2003** by the Government of India to institutionalize fiscal discipline.
 
• The primary objective of the FRBM Act is to ensure **long-term macroeconomic stability** by reducing fiscal deficits and promoting efficient management of public finances.
 
• The Act requires the government to set annual targets for reducing fiscal deficit and revenue deficit as a percentage of GDP.
 
• It mandates the presentation of a Medium-Term Fiscal Policy Statement and Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement along with the Union Budget.
 
• The FRBM Act was amended several times, with significant changes introduced in **2018**, including the adoption of a debt-to-ಚ target of 40% for the central government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fiscal Deficit:** It is the difference between the government's total expenditure and its total revenue, excluding borrowings. It indicates the extent to which the government needs to borrow to meet its expenses.
 
• **Revenue Deficit:** It refers to the shortfall in the government's revenue receipts compared to its revenue expenditure, excluding capital expenditures.
 
• **Debt-to-GDP Ratio:** This is a measure of a country's debt relative to its economic output. A lower ratio indicates better fiscal health.
 
• **Medium-Term Fiscal Policy Statement:** A document presented under the FRBM Act that outlines the government's fiscal objectives and policies for the coming three years.
 
• **Challenges in Implementation:** Factors such as global economic uncertainties, fluctuating tax revenues, and the need for increased spending during crises (e.g., pandemic) pose challenges in adhering to FRBM targets.
